name: Venusian intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

v2.say: Flares! Dreadful for the complexion. You know, the tankers that skim our cloud-tops have been riding sunward lately. Gyre Collective hulls, if you ask me — not that anyone asks Venus anything but skincare.

v1.say: Welcome, gorgeous, to the Cloud Court of Venus. Mind the acid rain — it's couture, not weather.

options.label: Flattered
options.text: Why thank you. I'm here about the solar flares.

options.label: Blunt
options.text: Skip the spa pitch. Who's burning up the sun?

v3.say: Rude AND sunburnt, tragic. Fine: ask the farm boys around Jupiter. Every freighter in the system refuels out there — fuel is gossip you can weigh.

v5.say: Take this parasol, darling — genuine cloudsilk. It repels flare-light AND judgment. Now go bother Jupiter; tell the Iowan outpost Venus misses their corn.
